name: Ezer
title: Priestly Lineage in David's Time
summary: Ezer was the head of one of the 24 priestly divisions that King David organized for service in the temple. His division was assigned the seventeenth lot among the 24 priestly courses. The name Ezer also appears among those who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's time.

keyEvents.title: The Organization of the Priestly Divisions
keyEvents.description: King David organized the priests into 24 divisions for service in the sanctuary. Ezer was assigned the seventeenth division by lot.

keyEvents.title: Ezer's Lot
keyEvents.description: By lot, the seventeenth fell to Ezer, which determined his division's week of service in the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: David's Arrangement for Temple Service
keyEvents.description: David established a structured system for Aaron's descendants through Zadok and Abiathar, where each division received its fixed time for service.

keyEvents.title: Ezer Mentioned in Nehemiah's Covenant
keyEvents.description: A person or family named Hesir was among the priests and Levites who sealed the covenant to follow God's law during Nehemiah's time after the exile.

keyEvents.title: The Priests' Commitment under Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Hesir's descendants were among those who committed themselves to keep God's commands and regulations when the people renewed their covenant with God after returning from Babylon.
